name: rich-context-aware-inspection-redaction
instr:
Rich cannot contextually redact sensitive inspection content while preserving protection through formatting and rendering. Add ordered literal, regular-expression, and structural-path decisions with safe, deterministic audit information. Preserve existing behavior when redaction is absent or unmatched.

The public `rich.redaction` module exposes `RedactionRule`, `RedactionPolicy`, `ProtectedRange`, `ProtectedText`, `RedactionEvent`, `RedactionReport`, and `InspectionRedaction`. `RedactionPolicy.__init__(self, rules)` preserves rule order, and the first match wins. Keep ranges and paths through editing, concatenation, recognized emoji aliases and variants, markup, highlighting, tables, panels, output, recording, and heterogeneous assembly of protected strings, styled tuples, and Text fragments. Preserve styles, metadata, configured line endings, and established literal treatment of unknown or malformed aliases.

Replacements must remain opaque to markup parsing and representation highlighting, receive only configured replacement styling, and leave neighboring content normal. Decide independently within each inspection fragment, including titles, values, attribute names and values, signatures, documentation, nested mappings, sequences, dataclasses, custom representations, and visible failures. Matches never span fragments. Without a policy, inspection reproduces base output byte for byte.
